modelOverview: The Royal Oak Perpetual Calendar 41mm is Audemars Piguet's flagship grand-complication in the iconic octagonal Royal Oak line, displaying day, date, month, week, leap year and astronomical moon phase without needing correction until 2100. This latest generation, introduced in 2025, is powered by the new ultra-thin self-winding Calibre 7138, whose patented mechanisms allow every calendar indication to be set via the crown alone, eliminating recessed pushers and the traditional adjustment 'danger zone'. It retains the slim 9.5mm case profile and signature Grande Tapisserie dial that define the collection.
